goalOneSentence: Produce a valid sprint.json that plans an HTTP smoke test for the internal quotes service (GET /quotes/latest must return 200 hermetically against a local mocker on port 8095).

tasks.title: Plan the quotes-service smoke-test sprint
tasks.description: USER GOAL: 'We have an internal quotes service. I want a QaaS smoke test that proves GET /quotes/latest returns HTTP 200 with exactly one response per request (hermetic), using a local static mocker on port 8095. Team name Quotes, system name QuoteHub.' YOUR JOB: apply the plan-test-sprint skill to emit planned/sprint.json (and nothing else) planning this work for a later generator. Requirements: exactly 3 tasks in canonical order (FB: scaffold priority 1 -> author YAML priority 2 -> run e2e priority 3) with dependsOn chaining; every task description fully self-contained (>=150 chars, no 'see other task' references) naming exact files, exact YAML/csproj fields, and FB s13 trap citations (at minimum s13#1 ProcessorConfiguration, s13#3 DataSourceNames, s13#5 Route slash, s13#12 ExpectedCount, s13#13 vacuous-pass guard in the relevant tasks); every task has verify[] entries with cmd plus expectExitCode or expectOutputContains (use dotnet build, dotnet run -- template, dotnet run -- run with port 8095); every task has acceptanceCriteria, rubric, failureModes, passes false, iterations 0. The sprintId must be QH1, feature and goalOneSentence must describe the quotes smoke test in one sentence.
acceptanceCriteria: planned/sprint.json parses as JSON and passes the structural validator
3 tasks, canonical priority order, no inversion
rubric: Descriptions would let a generator work without any other context
verify[] commands are real and runnable (no pseudo-commands)
Trap coverage: the five core s13 rows appear in the right tasks
failureModes: Task description references another task (context isolation violation)
